text: Hello, really sorry to message so late, I know you must be busy with more serious things. My daughter is 5 and she's come up in a rash this evening, little red blotches on her chest and back mostly. I did the glass thing I'd heard about and I think it goes pale when you press, it definatly fades under the glass, I tried it on a few diffrent bits to be sure. She's been weeing normally, been to the loo a few times tonight same as usual. And there's been no fit or shaking or anything like that, I've been watching her. I'm not sure if I'm just being paranoid, my wife says I worry too much and she's probably right. I just wasn't sure if a rash on its own is somthing that needs looking at or if we can wait and see how it is in the morning. I don't want to waste anyones time. Sorry again and thank you.
